assumptions: The existing Spring Cloud Data YARN codebase already provides baseline deployer and ModuleLauncher interfaces to extend and refactor.

Development uses Java 17+ and a Spring Boot version that exposes the JarLauncher API (e.g., Spring Boot 2.7+ or 3.x aligned with Spring Framework 6).
Deployment property parsing infrastructure already exists and can be extended with new yarn.* keys without major rework.
The manifest format (JSON/YAML) can be extended to include asset lists and library references without breaking existing consumers.
Effort estimates are for a single experienced Java/Spring developer and exclude meetings, training, production support, and elapsed calendar time.
Required Hadoop and Spring Cloud Data dependencies are already present in the project build configuration.
